title: Daily Temperatures
description:
Given an array of integers `temperatures` representing the daily temperatures, return an array `answer` of the same length such that `answer[i]` is the number of days you must wait after the `i`-th day to observe a strictly warmer temperature.

If there is no future day with a strictly warmer temperature than `temperatures[i]`, set `answer[i]` to `0`.
hints: For each day, you need the index of the first subsequent day with a strictly higher temperature.
Keep a monotonic decreasing stack of day indices whose warmer day has not yet been seen.
Whenever today's temperature exceeds the temperature at the top index of the stack, pop that index `prev` and set `answer[prev] = i - prev`.

examples.explanation: Day 0 (73) waits 1 day for 74; day 2 (75) waits 4 days for 76; days 6 (76) and 7 (73) have no warmer future day.
Temperatures increase every day, so every day except the last waits exactly 1 day.
Each day is immediately followed by a warmer day except the final day.
